introduction.purpose: Outline functional requirements for EventEase, a web-based event management system.
scope: Store and retrieve event data in database

functional_requirements.name: User Registration
functional_requirements.description: Allow users to create an account with email and password.

functional_requirements.name: User Login
functional_requirements.description: Allow registered users to log in securely.

functional_requirements.name: Create Event
functional_requirements.description: Allow users to create events with title, date, time, venue, theme, and guest list.

functional_requirements.name: Edit Event
functional_requirements.description: Allow users to modify event details.

functional_requirements.name: View Event Summary
functional_requirements.description: Display event information in a summary format.

functional_requirements.name: Manage Guests
functional_requirements.description: Allow hosts to add, remove, or edit guest information.

functional_requirements.name: Notifications
functional_requirements.description: Send reminders or updates to hosts and guests.

functional_requirements.name: Data Storage
functional_requirements.description: Store event and user data in a database.

nonfunctional_requirements.name: Maintainability
nonfunctional_requirements.description: Follow MVC and clean code patterns.
